{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial anti-security device''' was a round probe [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Trioculus]] to penetrate [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4's]] defense network and search for the [[Lost City of the Jedi]]. It was equipped with a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] and a remote detonation system.
